pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Terminal UI plugin for OpenCode that adds a live "Subagents" panel to the session sidebar, showing a coloured status icon and label for each tracked child session. Unofficial community project.
The plugin entry (`./tui` → `src/tui.tsx`) is loaded at OpenCode startup. The runtime resolves its imports (solid-js, @opentui/solid, @opentui/core) from a bundled node_modules tree.
Requires OpenCode >= 1.17.0 (declared by upstream `engines.opencode`) and Bun >= 1.3.14 (loads libopentui.so via FFI).
